# wso2is_claim (Data Source)

Reads a local claim by its claim URI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_claim" "email" {
  claim_uri = "http://wso2.org/claims/emailaddress"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_uri` (String) Claim URI, for example `http://wso2.org/claims/emailaddress`.

### Read-Only

- `attribute_mappings` (Map of String) User store attribute by user store domain.
- `data_type` (String) Data type.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) Claim ID.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether users can change it.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether a value is required.
- `supported_by_default` (Boolean) Whether it is shown in profiles.
